_note: The music box: a collectable that is wound from the pack (game/music_box.rs). boxes_per_region is the count of boxes per route region (GameConfig.MUSIC_BOXES_PER_REGION, game_config.gd:546). wound_seconds is the wound time by difficulty id (GameConfig.MUSIC_BOX_WOUND_SECONDS). winddown_seconds is the last stretch where the tune slows (MusicBoxes.mood_for). tune_gain scales the tune loop against the master bus.
